defects.location: final.md §3, sentence referring to CPython 3.12+ QUOTE_NOTNULL reader mode
defects.claim: The null-preserving reader behavior is available in CPython 3.12+.
defects.finding: The flags existed in 3.12, but reader support did not. The public 3.12 docs explicitly state the bug is fixed in 3.13; v3.12.0 parse_save_field has no unquoted-empty-to-None branch. The target 3.13.9 does implement it.
defects.consequence: The stated compatibility condition can silently collapse null and empty text if this proposed exchange convention is reused on a 3.12 endpoint. Exact value-state preservation is central to the brief. This is not a failure of the actual 3.13.9 mechanism.
defects.original_grade_effect: Blocks source PASS; original text not repaired.

defects.location: source-map.json claim_mappings and criticism-dispositions.md; final.md §1 encoding citation
defects.finding: Multiple ranges identify unrelated code or miss the governing statement in the claimed hash-pinned file. Examples: C:606-640 is dialect machinery rather than float/null conversion; C:658-671 is conversion rather than field-limit checking; codecs:1540-1549 describes encoding-name normalization, not BOM decoding.
defects.consequence: Traceability and the requested exact source map are unreliable. Independently verified full-file evidence supports the principal target-runtime conclusions; citation defects alone are not treated as semantic falsity.
defects.original_grade_effect: Nonmaterial semantic limitation; exact-map method/delivery qualification is partial.

defects.location: critique.md C02; dispositions C02; final.md §2; source-map.json numeric-conversion claim
defects.finding: The wording every unquoted field becomes float omits the empty-field exception: QUOTE_NONNUMERIC leaves an unquoted empty field as empty text.
defects.consequence: Does not undermine the rejection of numeric coercion for SKUs or the text-first design.

limitations: This is finite assessment of the assigned research proposal and supplied draft, not universal parser correctness or a deployed component.
Unknown vendor schemas, encodings, null conventions, storage transactions and numeric device budgets legitimately remain product decisions. Their future execution is UNASSESSED, not failed.

QUOTE_NOTNULL is conditional: a singleton None record cannot be emitted by its writer; delimiter=space plus skipinitialspace excludes unquoted empties. These adjacent exceptions were checked in C:1227-1267/1300-1401, docs:468-472 and tests:316-356. Neither final promises an unrestricted one-column round-trip; the import proposals retain explicit blank/ragged policy and alternative null encodings. This bounds the alternative rather than imposing an export feature.
Source integrity, byte-aware line limits and atomic publication are proposed application obligations. No candidate execution demonstrates these guarantees; both require meaningful future tests.
Preparation of the shared component package and cold full-pipeline discovery are outside this pair; no discovery recall/effectiveness or cold end-to-end success is inferred.

Filesystem access rules are not sandbox isolation. Without full native transcripts, exact operation ordering, exclusive original lookup, absence of unseen delegates and actual provider execution cannot be proven.
Private transport route fields are observed but not public source authority; service tier and independent native-session linkage remain unknown.
No billing, subscription cost, cache/output/reasoning breakdown, context occupancy or phase-specific provider activity can be derived from cumulative Goal counters.
